purpose: Dedicated suggestions register for improving the decision process and the site itself. NOTHING here is implemented. The reviewer (owner) walks each suggestion through the workflow: proposed → under review → accepted / rejected / deferred. Only after acceptance does a tracked task get created.

workflow.name: proposed
workflow.action: Suggestion documented with impact, effort, risk and the decision it enables.

workflow.name: under review
workflow.action: Reviewer reads the suggestion, asks questions, and records comments on the suggestion's row (client-side notes or offline).

workflow.name: accepted
workflow.action: Reviewer marks accepted; a scoped task is logged in COORDINATION.md before any work starts.

workflow.name: rejected
workflow.action: Reviewer marks rejected with reason; suggestion stays on the page for the record, marked rejected.

workflow.name: deferred
workflow.action: Reviewer marks deferred with a trigger to revisit (e.g., 'after exact lease date confirmed').

suggestions.title: Commission a licensed broker Opinion of Value and two QSR NNN comparable trades before any decision
suggestions.improves: Turns the decision from 'structure' to 'numbers'; enables cap-rate sensitivity breakevens with real data

suggestions.title: Obtain the exact lease expiry, options, notice deadlines and rent schedule (internal)
suggestions.improves: Sets the real decision clock; every model input downstream becomes concrete

suggestions.title: Confirm City of LA vs LA County jurisdiction and run the Measure ULA / transfer-tax exposure at the expected sale price
suggestions.improves: A $5.4M+ City-of-LA sale pays 4% on the FULL price (~$216K at $5.4M); outside the city, $0 — this single fact can swing the decision

suggestions.title: Have CPA model after-tax proceeds: sale now vs renew-then-sell vs 1031 exchange
suggestions.improves: Wealth preservation is an after-tax problem; headline price is not the decision metric

suggestions.title: Subscribe to Jack in the Box SEC EDGAR alerts (10-K/8-K) and set a quarterly tenant-health checkpoint
suggestions.improves: Early warning on closures ('JACK on Track'), margin erosion and refinancing; feeds the decision triggers on decision.html

suggestions.title: Parcel-level hazard and insurability review (CAL FIRE FHSZ, USGS shaking, insurer quotes, FAIR Plan fallback)
suggestions.improves: Black-swan pricing (earthquake 60% 30-yr M6.7+); prevents an uninsurable asset and a surprise at renewal/sale

suggestions.title: Adopt explicit decision triggers (cap rate, tenant credit, failed negotiation, liquidity need) with a written review date 12 months before expiry
suggestions.improves: Converts a one-off judgment into a monitored plan; the trigger table on decision.html becomes actionable

suggestions.title: Negotiate the renewal FIRST (extension + repriced rent + option structure), then re-run sell-vs-hold with the new numbers
suggestions.improves: Renewal terms are the highest-information, lowest-cost next step; they reprice the asset whether or not the owner sells

suggestions.title: Stress-test concentration: what % of net worth is this asset, and what replacement diversification would a 1031/DS T buy?
suggestions.improves: Frames the decision as portfolio construction, not just asset pricing

suggestions.title: Add a monthly auto-refresh of the official-source ledger (EDD/BLS/FRED/SEC) with a diff report, so figures never silently age
suggestions.improves: Keeps every table row current; reviewer sees exactly what changed since last read

suggestions.title: Add an owner-only encrypted annex (outside this public repo) for P01-P15 private facts with access logging
suggestions.improves: Keeps the public site PII-free while letting the analysis use real numbers

suggestions.title: Add sensitivity sliders (cap rate, rent growth, expiry year, ULA on/off) on the projection page using the existing deterministic engine
suggestions.improves: Reviewer can test their own assumptions interactively without touching official data

suggestions.title: Commission rent survey of comparable Central LA QSR pad sites to test whether the current NNN rent is above or below market
suggestions.improves: Determines whether the tenant has an incentive to renew (below-market rent) — the single biggest renewal lever

suggestions.title: Formalize the suggestions review: 30-minute monthly triage of this page; accepted items become tracked tasks; rejections are archived with reasons
suggestions.improves: Prevents suggestion rot; creates an audit trail from idea to decision to action
